author: HenryYHW
description:
🚗 ADAS-TO
	

A large-scale naturalistic dataset of real-world Level-2 ADAS → human control transitions.
16,446 takeover clips · 364 drivers · 179 vehicle models · 2,585 routes · ~41 GB
Each clip is a self-contained 20 s multimodal record centered on an automation disengagement:
front-view video plus 13 synchronized CAN / perception / IMU signal files.


	
		
	
	
		Why this dataset
	

Most takeover research comes from simulators or small scripted road experiments. ADAS-TO instead… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/HenryYHW/ADAS-TO.
